Class RestPkiDocumentSigner

Namespace
NuvTools.Security.Certificate.Lacuna
Assembly
NuvTools.Security.Certificate.Lacuna.dll

Signs PDFs (PAdES) through Lacuna REST PKI. The client signs the challenge in the browser with Web PKI (signWithRestPki); reading certificates, preparing the document and completing the signature all happen on the service, so no key or licence is kept locally.
